cards.title: Timing Chain
cards.body: We inspect and replace timing chain components as standard during a rebuild.

cards.title: Bearings
cards.body: We replace main bearings and connecting rod bearings as standard during a rebuild.

cards.title: Gaskets & Seals
cards.body: We replace all gaskets and seals as standard during a rebuild.

cards.title: Twin-Scroll Turbocharger
cards.body: The TDV6 SDV6's twin-scroll turbocharger is a key component that is removed, inspected, and refurbished or replaced as part of the rebuild.

cards.title: Additional Inspected Components
cards.body: Fuel injectors, high-pressure fuel pump, PCV system, timing chain tensioners and guides, and cooling system components are all measured and inspected.

notice: Components drawn directly from VRF Key Components data. If your TDV6 SDV6's exact ancillary set isn't covered above, we confirm the full scope once your engine is inspected — not guessed in advance.

groups.title: Replaced as Standard
items: Timing chain assembly (chains, guides, tensioners) — critical known issue
Main bearings and connecting rod bearings — critical known issue

groups.title: Inspected and Measured
items: Crankshaft — most feared failure is a snapped crankshaft
Timing chain tensioners (cold-start chain rattle that clears after 10–15 seconds is not normal)
Timing belt (on some variants — belt breakage causes catastrophic failure)
Turbocharger components (single or twin-turbo depending on variant)
